fieldValues.title: muDemocracy.org main CI red since 2026-10-30: corpus work committed as found fails the coherence gate
fieldValues.summary: Every CI run on muDemocracy.org main from 3d27cdd (2026-10-30, "committed as found") to d2e410e (2026-11-02) failed: muSrs coherence reports 49 errors (publication-reachability: records in no container; one-home: records with two contains parents; note-source-membership) and two runs were killed by runner shutdowns. Found while preparing holon muDemocracy.org#418, whose every muDemocracy item would inherit the red gate.
evidence: muDemocracy.org#418 stop S1: PRs show baseline honesty against the last main run
